meta.title: Increase Event Time: Increase event time using 30 minutes option succeeds

plan.title: Increase RFQ Submission Time by 30 Minutes

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with Vendor A's bid.
Navigate to the RFQ stage whose submission time will be extended.
Open the RFQ Responses view described in the case.
Open Extend Submission Time, choose the 30-minute option, confirm it, and verify the end time moves forward by 30 minutes.
Verify the success toast reported after the extension is saved.
